BFS removes the oldest frontier entry using a FIFO queue. Start with the root, remove the head, test it, append unseen successors at the tail, and repeat. It explores depths 0,1,2,… and is complete for finite b and a finite-depth goal. It minimizes number of edges, so minimum cost requires equal positive step costs.

DFS follows the deepest pending branch using a LIFO stack or recursion. FILO means the same order as LIFO. With the same children as BFS, a left-first DFS visits S,A,C before B; push rightmost children first to pop the leftmost first.

Local search keeps a complete candidate configuration and improves its objective; the path may be irrelevant. Hill climbing chooses better neighbors. First-improvement accepts the first improvement; steepest-ascent examines all neighbors; stochastic variants choose among improvements. Local maxima, plateaus and ridges can stop progress. Random restarts or limited sideways steps can help without guaranteeing success.

Narrow or weak AI addresses bounded tasks, such as face recognition, spam filtering or a voice assistant. General AI denotes broad competence transferable across domains; strong AI also has a philosophical meaning involving actual understanding. Do not equate a humanoid body, autonomous vehicle, or many features with general intelligence.

Learning is improvement on task T, measured by P, through experience E. For spam filtering, T is classifying email, E is past labeled messages, and P might be recall at a required precision. Exploration trades immediate reward for information; exploitation uses the best action currently known. Learning can improve reflex, goal-based or utility-based agents.

evidence.quote: A simple reflex agent matches condition–action rules against the current percept only: if dirty, clean. It has no persistent world-state memory. A goal-based agent considers future action sequences that reach a desired state. A utility-based agent compares degrees of desirability and trade-offs, choosing maximum expected utility: EU(a)=Σs P(s|a,evidence)U(s). Reaching the destination is a goal; balancing arrival time, safety and cost requires preferences among outcomes.

The performance element selects actions. The learning element changes the agent to improve future performance. The critic evaluates behavior against a performance standard and supplies feedback. The problem generator suggests exploratory actions likely to yield useful experience.

evidence.quote: BFS removes the oldest frontier entry using a FIFO queue. Start with the root, remove the head, test it, append unseen successors at the tail, and repeat. It explores depths 0,1,2,… and is complete for finite b and a finite-depth goal. It minimizes number of edges, so minimum cost requires equal positive step costs.

DFS follows the deepest pending branch using a LIFO stack or recursion. FILO means the same order as LIFO. With the same children as BFS, a left-first DFS visits S,A,C before B; push rightmost children first to pop the leftmost first.

DLS runs DFS to depth ℓ and reports cutoff separately from failure. It misses goals deeper than ℓ. Iterative deepening runs DLS with limits 0,1,2,…; for finite b it finds the shallowest solution with O(b^d) time and O(bd) frontier space, optimal for equal step costs. Repeated shallow work is small compared with the deepest level.

evidence.quote: DLS runs DFS to depth ℓ and reports cutoff separately from failure. It misses goals deeper than ℓ. Iterative deepening runs DLS with limits 0,1,2,…; for finite b it finds the shallowest solution with O(b^d) time and O(bd) frontier space, optimal for equal step costs. Repeated shallow work is small compared with the deepest level.

BFS removes the oldest frontier entry using a FIFO queue. Start with the root, remove the head, test it, append unseen successors at the tail, and repeat. It explores depths 0,1,2,… and is complete for finite b and a finite-depth goal. It minimizes number of edges, so minimum cost requires equal positive step costs.

DFS follows the deepest pending branch using a LIFO stack or recursion. FILO means the same order as LIFO. With the same children as BFS, a left-first DFS visits S,A,C before B; push rightmost children first to pop the leftmost first.

answer_review.explanation: Supervised, unsupervised and semi-supervised learning differ in the target labels available during training. Deductive reasoning instead derives consequences from premises using truth-preserving rules. Deduction can be used inside a learning system, so the distinction is not that the two can never coexist. The question separates a reasoning method from the conventional label-availability taxonomy.

evidence.quote: Supervised learning fits a mapping from labeled input–target examples. Classification predicts discrete labels, such as institution generations or spam/nonspam; regression predicts numeric quantities, such as prices. Predictive analytics uses historical patterns to forecast outcomes and can use either. Specify the target before choosing a method.

Unsupervised learning seeks structure without target labels: clustering groups similar examples; association finds co-occurrence; dimensionality reduction compresses features. Good clusters have high within-cluster similarity and low between-cluster similarity under an appropriate distance. K-means alternates assignment to nearest centroids and centroid updates.

Semi-supervised learning combines some labels with additional unlabeled data. Active learning chooses informative cases for an oracle to label; it still uses labels. “Exploratory learning” is not an exclusive standard synonym: it can mean unsupervised exploration or active data acquisition, so define the feedback. A task named summarization or time-series analysis is not automatically supervised; its training targets determine that.

Deduction applies truth-preserving rules: all people are mortal; Ada is a person; therefore Ada is mortal. Induction generalizes observations to a broader rule and can be overturned by new examples. Abduction proposes a plausible explanation: wet ground suggests rain, although sprinklers could explain it. Analogy transfers a pattern between similar situations.

evidence.quote: DLS runs DFS to depth ℓ and reports cutoff separately from failure. It misses goals deeper than ℓ. Iterative deepening runs DLS with limits 0,1,2,…; for finite b it finds the shallowest solution with O(b^d) time and O(bd) frontier space, optimal for equal step costs. Repeated shallow work is small compared with the deepest level.

DFS follows the deepest pending branch using a LIFO stack or recursion. FILO means the same order as LIFO. With the same children as BFS, a left-first DFS visits S,A,C before B; push rightmost children first to pop the leftmost first.

evidence.quote: A Bayesian network is a directed acyclic graph with conditional probability tables; its joint distribution factors as the product of each node’s probability given its parents. A Markov model assumes the next state depends on the current state rather than the entire past. These represent uncertainty; fuzzy membership represents a different issue.

A semantic network connects concept nodes by labeled relations such as is-a. Frames describe stereotyped entities through slots, values and defaults. Production systems use IF conditions THEN conclusions or actions, matching rules against working memory and selecting among applicable rules. A graph suits relationships such as frequently bought together; frames suit attributes. No representation is always best for recommendation without task requirements.

An ontology describes entities or individuals, classes and properties and may state logical relationships and restrictions. It organizes explicit conceptual knowledge. Conditional probability tables and a probabilistic factorization are additional modeling commitments, not inherent in the word ontology.

evidence.quote: A search node records a state plus parent, action, depth and path cost. Expanding a node generates its successors. OPEN or frontier stores discovered candidates awaiting expansion; CLOSED records expanded states. Reaching the same state through different paths does not imply the same node or cost.

BFS removes the oldest frontier entry using a FIFO queue. Start with the root, remove the head, test it, append unseen successors at the tail, and repeat. It explores depths 0,1,2,… and is complete for finite b and a finite-depth goal. It minimizes number of edges, so minimum cost requires equal positive step costs.

Locomotion may be legged, wheeled or tracked, with trade-offs in terrain, stability and efficiency. Software can act autonomously without being a robot. Humanoid shape is not evidence of general intelligence.

evidence.quote: DHCP supplies addresses and configuration options. Typical initial IPv4 allocation is Discover→Offer→Request→ACK. The server manages its scope/pool, allocated leases, exclusions and reservations; options may include mask, gateway and DNS servers. A dynamic lease lasts for a specified interval, not forever.

Use a scope matching the subnet, exclude manually assigned server/router addresses, set correct options and provide a relay when client broadcasts must cross a router. The nine ordinary permission bits are owner, group and other triplets. In each triplet read=4,write=2,execute=1; sum enabled bits to get an octal digit. A leading ls -l character denotes file type, not another permission bit. For directories, read lists names, execute permits traversal/search, and write changes entries subject to other checks. File deletion usually depends on parent directory permissions, with sticky-bit/ACL rules also possible.

Deleting can be an explicit permission; therefore an OS-unspecified question claiming Delete is not a permission is false in Windows. Modify and full control are not identical: full control includes changing permission/ownership capabilities. Separate data access from logon rights. A user allowed to read a file is not necessarily allowed to write it or administer its parent folder.

answer_review.explanation: The leading hyphen identifies an ordinary file and is not a permission bit. Split the remaining characters as rwx | r-- | r--. The owner has 4+2+1=7, the group has read only (4), and others have read only (4). Writing those three octal digits in order gives 744, so A is correct.

evidence.quote: The nine ordinary permission bits are owner, group and other triplets. In each triplet read=4,write=2,execute=1; sum enabled bits to get an octal digit. A leading ls -l character denotes file type, not another permission bit. For directories, read lists names, execute permits traversal/search, and write changes entries subject to other checks. File deletion usually depends on parent directory permissions, with sticky-bit/ACL rules also possible.

choices.label: A
choices.explanation: 744 exactly represents owner rwx, group r-- and others r--.

choices.label: B
choices.explanation: 700 would deny both group and others all permissions, unlike the two read permissions shown.

choices.label: C
choices.explanation: 755 would give group and others execute permission as well as read permission; those execute bits are absent.

choices.label: D
choices.explanation: 766 would give group and others write permission; neither triplet contains w.

evidence.quote: RAID0 stripes for capacity/throughput with no disk-failure tolerance. RAID1 mirrors; a two-disk mirror has one disk’s usable capacity and survives one disk failure. RAID2 uses bit striping/Hamming-code redundancy, RAID3 byte striping with dedicated parity, RAID4 block striping with dedicated parity and RAID5 block striping with distributed parity. RAID6 distributes dual parity and tolerates two disk failures. RAID10 stripes mirrored pairs; survival depends on which disks fail.

With N equal disks of capacity D, RAID0 usable=ND, paired RAID1/10≈ND/2, RAID5=(N−1)D and RAID6=(N−2)D. Hardware RAID may offload work to controller resources/cache but does not universally outperform software RAID. Rebuilds consume bandwidth; parity writes have overhead. A large university/bank alone does not select a level. Striping plus parity is not uniquely RAID5 unless distributed block parity is specified.

evidence.quote: A security policy states required behavior, scope, accountable roles and enforcement. Begin with assets/service objectives, assess threats and weaknesses, choose controls, define exceptions/incident procedures, approve/communicate, monitor and periodically review. CIA means confidentiality, integrity and availability; neither sensitive-data protection nor availability alone is the universal primary goal.

A policy can require password controls, approved encryption, restricted administrative access, backups and patch deadlines; firewall rules implement part of it. Open unrestricted wireless access conflicts with controlled internal access unless intentionally isolated as a guest service. “Use the system passively” is not a purpose of security policy. Policies coordinate action and reduce risk; they do not guarantee every attack will fail.

Throwable is the root of throwable values, with Exception and Error branches. RuntimeException and Error subclasses are unchecked; other throwable classes are checked.

Checked does not mean the exception occurs at compile time: the compiler checks an obligation to catch or declare it, while an actual throw occurs at runtime. A custom exception can extend Exception or RuntimeException. Error normally signals serious conditions for which routine recovery is inappropriate; it is not technically impossible to catch an Error.

Encapsulation groups related state and operations and controls access. Information hiding keeps implementation decisions behind a stable interface. An accessor/getter returns information; a mutator/setter changes state. Encapsulation does not require blindly generating setters for every field: validate changes and expose only useful operations. For a bank account, deposit must reject negative amounts.

OOP11 cautions that automatically exposing setters for every field is not required.

Strict alternation uses turn=0/1: process i waits while turn≠i, then enters and sets turn to the other process on leaving. It enforces turns but can violate progress if the other process stays outside its critical region. A naive lock-variable test followed by a separate set races because both processes can observe free before either sets it.

Test-and-set and compare-and-swap combine checking/updating atomically; ordinary check-then-write does not. Peterson’s classic algorithm uses flags plus turn for two processes under its memory-model assumptions; a semaphore can coordinate more than two. Disabling local interrupts does not exclude other CPUs and is not a general user-space locking solution.
A race occurs when results depend on uncoordinated interleaving of conflicting accesses.

answer_review.hint: Track who may enter and distinguish separate tests and updates from atomic operations.
answer_review.explanation: OS12 defines strict alternation using turn=0/1: each process waits until turn equals its identifier and passes the turn on leaving. That directly matches the described integer ownership variable. A naive lock variable instead records availability and can race during separate test/set operations. Disabling interrupts and a race condition do not implement the described turn-taking algorithm.

evidence.quote: The ready queue contains eligible work; device queues hold blocked requests. The broad textbook job queue contains processes in the system, while an admission queue more narrowly holds jobs awaiting memory/admission. Long-term scheduling admits jobs; medium-term scheduling suspends/swaps them; short-term scheduling selects ready work. The dispatcher performs the handoff/context restore after selection. A bare “priority” causes running→ready only if a preemptive policy chooses another process.

The kernel implements core resource management, protection and system-call handling.

Firmware/bootloader stages execute before transferring control to a kernel loaded into RAM. The kernel is the first core OS component, not the first program ever executed at power-on. Loadable modules can add drivers to a running kernel; “kernel modules cannot be loaded while running” is false in modular systems. A resident kernel remains active through the session. Utilities such as antivirus and disk tools can combine user processes with privileged components.

evidence.quote: First-fit selects the first adequate hole; next-fit continues from the previous search position; best-fit selects the smallest adequate hole; worst-fit selects the largest.

questions.hint: Apply the stated hole-selection or base-and-bound rule with its explicit convention.

answer_review.hint: Apply the stated hole-selection or base-and-bound rule with its explicit convention.
answer_review.explanation: Best-fit chooses the smallest hole large enough for the request: 200, leaving 20 unused units. First-fit stops at 500 and leaves 320 units; worst-fit also chooses 500. A semaphore provides atomic wait/P/down and signal/V/up operations. Under the nonnegative-token model, wait consumes one available token or blocks when none is available; signal supplies a token and may wake a waiter. Implementations using negative internal counts encode waiters differently, so state the model. A binary semaphore represents one permit; a counting semaphore tracks several. A mutex normally has ownership rules that a general semaphore lacks.

Test-and-set and compare-and-swap combine checking/updating atomically; ordinary check-then-write does not. Peterson’s classic algorithm uses flags plus turn for two processes under its memory-model assumptions; a semaphore can coordinate more than two.

This is a typical comparison, not a universal speed or reliability guarantee.

Kernel component code executes in privileged kernel mode and performs permitted low-level hardware operations.

Direct message communication names the receiving process explicitly. Indirect communication uses a mailbox or port. This naming distinction is independent of whether a send or receive blocks: naming a destination does not determine synchronization semantics.

evidence.quote: A thread has its own PC, registers and stack. Threads in a process share code, address space and usually open-file resources. A process can contain many threads; a thread belongs to one process at a time. Threads are not a group of processes and need not execute sequentially. Independent processes can exist; cooperating ones communicate/share data.

User-level threads are managed by a library; kernel threads are known to the OS. In many-to-one mapping, a blocking kernel call can block all user threads and one kernel execution context cannot use multiple CPUs simultaneously. One-to-one permits another kernel thread to run when one blocks. Many-to-many multiplexes user threads over several kernel threads.

A race occurs when results depend on uncoordinated interleaving of conflicting accesses. A critical section is code accessing shared state that needs protection, not the resource itself. A correct exclusion solution requires mutual exclusion, progress and bounded waiting under stated assumptions. Mutual exclusion is a desired safety property; races, starvation and deadlock are possible failures.

Keep critical regions small and ensure every conflicting access uses the same protection. A barrier waits until a defined set of participants reaches a point; a monitor encapsulates protected operations with condition synchronization. Locking can itself introduce deadlock if acquisition order is inconsistent.

answer_review.hint: Identify conflicting shared accesses and the safety or progress property required.
answer_review.explanation: Conflicting accesses need coordination so interleaving does not corrupt shared state or violate required operation order. Critical-section protection provides mutual exclusion, with progress and bounded waiting required under the stated solution assumptions. Synchronization does not automatically eliminate deadlock; inconsistent lock acquisition can introduce it. It may also serialize work rather than create parallelism, so safe shared-access coordination is the precise primary purpose.

evidence.quote: FCFS runs ready bursts in arrival order and ordinarily does not preempt.

All ready at time 0, tie order P1=24,P2=3,P3=3: schedule 0–24 P1,24–27 P2,27–30 P3. Waiting times 0,24,27 average to 17. Turnarounds 24,27,30 average to 27. If arrivals are not simultaneous, recompute using their actual times.
For arrival A, first start S and completion C, response=S−A and turnaround=C−A. For a single CPU burst B with no I/O, waiting=C−A−B.

answer_review.hint: Follow arrival order, include idle periods and distinguish waiting from completion time.
answer_review.explanation: FCFS runs P1 from 0 to 24 ms, P2 from 24 to 27 ms, and P3 from 27 to 30 ms. Because every process arrives at 0, their waiting times are 0, 24 and 27 ms. The average is (0+24+27)/3 = 51/3 = 17 ms, so C is correct. The average turnaround is a different quantity: (24+27+30)/3 = 27 ms.

evidence.quote: A semaphore provides atomic wait/P/down and signal/V/up operations. Under the nonnegative-token model, wait consumes one available token or blocks when none is available; signal supplies a token and may wake a waiter. Implementations using negative internal counts encode waiters differently, so state the model. A binary semaphore represents one permit; a counting semaphore tracks several. A mutex normally has ownership rules that a general semaphore lacks.
FCFS runs ready bursts in arrival order and ordinarily does not preempt.
A contiguous allocation gives a process one continuous region.
Contiguous allocation uses consecutive blocks; logical block i is start+i and supports direct access, but growth and external fragmentation are problems.

evidence.quote: A race occurs when results depend on uncoordinated interleaving of conflicting accesses. A critical section is code accessing shared state that needs protection, not the resource itself. A correct exclusion solution requires mutual exclusion, progress and bounded waiting under stated assumptions. Mutual exclusion is a desired safety property; races, starvation and deadlock are possible failures.

Keep critical regions small and ensure every conflicting access uses the same protection. A barrier waits until a defined set of participants reaches a point; a monitor encapsulates protected operations with condition synchronization. Locking can itself introduce deadlock if acquisition order is inconsistent.

evidence.quote: A hard link is another name for the same underlying file object, usually within one filesystem; a symbolic link stores a pathname and can point across filesystems or become dangling. Removing one hard link does not erase content while other names/open references retain it.

The old and new names identify the same file, so hard links are not a Windows-only facility. unlink() removes a filesystem name; when that name is a symbolic link, it removes the link itself. Removing a name and erasing the target’s contents are different operations.

Corrective maintenance fixes faults; adaptive maintenance responds to environment changes; perfective maintenance improves useful capability/performance; preventive maintenance reduces future risk, such as restructuring fragile code. Motive determines category; refactoring can support preventive or perfective work. Maintenance often lasts years and includes understanding legacy code and regression effort, so it may dominate lifecycle cost.

evidence.quote: Software engineering applies systematic methods to development, operation and maintenance. A process defines activities, ordering, roles, products and entry/exit conditions. Its four broad activities are specification, design/implementation, validation and evolution.

Procedural decomposition organizes functions; object oriented decomposition organizes objects with state and behavior. Either can use iterative or sequential development. OOP does not automatically shorten every project. Reuse, encapsulation and consistent models can reduce duplication and ease change; poor object design can still be complex. Functional programming emphasizes function evaluation and controlled side effects; event-driven programs react to events.

An object-oriented approach can use a consistent vocabulary of objects, classes and relationships across analysis, design and implementation. Models are refined for different purposes rather than being identical artifacts. This continuity can reduce translation errors and effort; reusable classes can shorten suitable projects, but neither shorter duration nor good design is guaranteed.

evidence.quote: Traditional CPM uses point durations; PERT models uncertainty with optimistic a, most-likely m and pessimistic b. The classic estimate is TE=(a+4m+b)/6 and variance=((b-a)/6)^2. For 3,6,15 days, TE=42/6=7 days and variance=4 days². Do not replace the weighted estimate by a simple average. These formulas are approximations, not guaranteed actual completion times.

A simple average would give 8, but that discards the fourfold weighting of the most-likely estimate. The expected duration is an estimate, not a guaranteed actual completion time.

evidence.quote: Statement coverage is the number of distinct executable statements exercised divided by the total executable statements in the declared test scope. Unreachable statements can prevent100%; any justified exclusions must be documented with the adjusted scope. Decision coverage counts decision outcomes; branch coverage counts control-flow edges, including unconditional edges under the stated convention. Testing both true and false of each decision may need more than two overall test cases when branches nest. Coverage is evidence of exercised structure, not proof of all behavior.

In the width/length/height bank program, the outer if has separate inner decisions in each branch. Need outer true with inner true and false, and outer false with its inner true and false: four tests, for example (w,l,h)=(3,2,4),(3,2,1),(2,3,4),(2,3,1). One run cannot exercise both outer branches. All paths may be infeasible or infinite with loops; specify the chosen coverage target.

answer_review.hint: Separate testing scope, technique and purpose. Use the stated workload, observable result or coverage target rather than a universal ranking.

One execution cannot visit both outer branches, so two or three tests cannot suffice; six are unnecessary.

evidence.quote: An activity diagram models workflow: filled circle start, rounded actions, guarded decision diamond, thick fork/join bars and partitions/swimlanes for responsibility. A diamond can also merge alternative flows; a join synchronizes concurrent flows. A state machine models states and transitions triggered by events, often with guards/actions, for one object’s lifecycle.

Sequence diagrams show interactions across lifelines, with order/time generally downward. Messages cross between participants; activation rectangles show execution. A creation message starts a lifeline; an X marks modeled destruction, not a guarantee about when a garbage collector runs. Synchronous calls wait for completion; asynchronous messages permit the sender to proceed.

A class box lists name, attributes and operations; + public, - private, # protected and ~ package indicate visibility. A class diagram shows static types and relationships, while an object diagram shows particular instances/links.

evidence.quote: Choose incremental delivery when prioritized partial capability must reach users early. Classical waterfall separates planned phases with reviewed deliverables. It fits well-understood, stable requirements and familiar technology; late feedback makes changes costly. It does not make change physically impossible: real projects revisit work under control, and modified waterfall explicitly includes feedback. Rigidity offers milestone visibility but can freeze incorrect assumptions.

Spiral development is risk driven. Each cycle identifies objectives and alternatives, assesses and reduces important risks, develops/verifies an appropriate next result, and plans further commitment. A prototype may test a risky technology before a large investment. The amount and type of work depend on the risks.

Scrum uses timeboxed Sprints of at most one month, with a Sprint Goal, selected work and a usable Increment meeting a Definition of Done. Scope is discussed before and during planning; it is not forbidden to agree scope. Timeboxes tend to stay fixed while content is adapted without endangering the goal. Agile can be combined with required assurance/documentation; safety-critical context alone cannot prove it is unsuitable.

evidence.quote: SOLID includes Single Responsibility, Open–Closed, Liskov substitution, Interface Segregation and Dependency Inversion.

evidence.quote: Choose incremental delivery when prioritized partial capability must reach users early. Smaller changes can be easier to debug and permit feedback, though architecture and integration still require planning. Iteration need not rebuild the whole system every time, and increments need not be perfectly independent modules. Broad descriptions of early working software can fit prototypes, iterative or Agile processes; identify the purpose of that early version.

answer_review.explanation: Successive deliveries that each add part of the required usable functionality define incremental development. Those can overlap with staged delivery, but incremental is the specific name for the delivery organization stated.

additions.title: Query representations and relational operators
paragraphs: A relation is represented by a table of tuples. Selection filters its rows by a predicate; projection retains chosen columns. A Cartesian product constructs every pair of input tuples. A matching join combines tuples satisfying its predicate, and can be represented as a selection over a product. Sorting orders results, while grouping collects rows sharing grouping values; these are different operations.

A query tree corresponds to a relational-algebra expression: base relations appear at leaves and operators at internal nodes. A query graph represents the predicate relationships of a relational-calculus expression without itself prescribing an operator execution order. An optimizer can transform the representation and choose access paths; the representation is not the query result.

additions.title: Transaction boundaries and savepoints
paragraphs: In SQL transaction-block notation, BEGIN starts a block, COMMIT completes it successfully, and ROLLBACK cancels its uncommitted changes. Committing requests a durable transaction outcome; it is distinct from merely finishing the last read or write operation.

SAVEPOINT marks an intermediate position inside the current transaction. ROLLBACK TO discards changes made after that position while retaining earlier work in the transaction. A savepoint is not an independent durable commit, and rolling back to it does not itself commit the retained changes.

additions.title: Availability and evidence against false denial
paragraphs: Availability concerns keeping services and resources accessible to their authorized users. Non-repudiation concerns evidence that an event or action occurred and who originated it, so a participant cannot falsely deny it. Neither property specifies which particular user has permission to change a database row; that is the separate authorization decision.

additions.title: Elementary binary locks and shared-lock compatibility
paragraphs: An elementary binary lock has two states: free and held. A request on a free item sets the lock to held; a request on an already-held item waits until release. That simple model does not distinguish shared readers from a writer. Shared/exclusive locking adds modes so multiple shared readers can coexist while incompatible exclusive access is excluded.

additions.title: Classify a failure by its stated cause
paragraphs: A software failure originates in erroneous program behavior, such as a logical programming defect, invalid operation or operating-system fault. A hardware failure originates in malfunctioning physical equipment; loss of disk contents is media failure. An accidental user deletion is human error even if the software executes the requested command correctly. Physical catastrophes such as fire can also cause failure. The observed symptom of a crash does not alone identify which cause occurred.

additions.title: Computability, complexity and abstract machines
paragraphs: Computability theory asks whether an effective algorithm can solve a problem at all. For a decision problem, a decision procedure must terminate with the correct yes-or-no result on every input.

Computational complexity theory studies the time and memory resources required to solve problems as functions of encoded input size. Automata theory studies abstract machine models and the languages they recognize; these subjects overlap but ask different questions.

sources.title: Automata and complexity theory · PDF page 15
Automata and complexity theory · PDF page 2
Automata and complexity theory · PDF page 16

additions.title: The stack discipline and its queue contrast
paragraphs: A stack is last-in, first-out: push adds an item at the top and pop removes the top item, so the most recently pushed item is removed first. A PDA accesses this top rather than an arbitrary interior position.

A queue is first-in, first-out: insertion at the rear and removal at the front returns the oldest waiting item. A linked list can implement a storage discipline, but the implementation container is different from the abstract push/pop or enqueue/dequeue access rule.

sources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 6
Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 7
Oracle Java SE 17: Deque stack and queue semantics

additions.title: Why satisfiability was the first NP-complete problem
paragraphs: Boolean satisfiability was the first problem proved NP-complete, through the Cook–Levin theorem. Its hardness proof starts directly from an arbitrary nondeterministic polynomial-time computation and constructs a Boolean formula that is satisfiable exactly when an accepting computation exists.

This starting point matters: once one NP-complete problem is available, later hardness proofs can reduce that known problem to a new target. Membership in NP remains a separate obligation. Checking a satisfying assignment is efficient; whether finding one is always polynomial-time remains unresolved.

sources.title: University of Toronto CSC373: Complexity, slide 28

additions.title: Finite procedures are different from undecidable tasks
paragraphs: Sorting a finite numeric list is a terminating computation. Quicksort, for example, chooses a pivot, partitions the other entries and recursively sorts the smaller sublists. Each recursive subproblem has fewer entries. A large running time does not make the task undecidable.

A finite linear system with exactly represented rational coefficients can be processed by Gaussian elimination and back substitution. Row exchanges handle unsuitable pivots; row reduction detects inconsistency or leaves free variables describing multiple solutions. These finite algebraic procedures differ from a general halting decider, which does not exist.

sources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 11
MIT OpenCourseWare — Solving Ax = b: row reduced form R

additions.title: Parser direction, expression parsing and coverage
paragraphs: The common two-way classification of parsing is by construction direction: top-down parsing expands from the start symbol, while bottom-up parsing reduces the input toward that symbol. This counts broad directions, not the number of parser algorithms or implementations.

Operator-precedence parsing is a restricted bottom-up expression-parsing method using a stack and precedence relations. With a suitable expression grammar, the stack retains unfinished surrounding expressions while nested parentheses are processed.

In the standard comparison by grammar coverage, canonical LR(1) is more general than the restricted operator-precedence method. Together with SLR(1)⊆LALR(1)⊆LR(1), this makes canonical LR(1) the broadest of those named deterministic parsing methods. Broader coverage does not mean faster execution or smaller tables.

sources.title: NIT Warangal Compiler Design Lab: operator-precedence parsing
NYU Compiler Construction: simple LR parsing and grammar coverage
Crespi Reghizzi and Pradella: Higher-order Operator Precedence Languages

additions.title: Grammar notation and general CFG parsing algorithms
paragraphs: Backus–Naur form, or BNF, is a notation for context-free grammar production rules. It describes how syntactic constructs are formed; it is different from an abstract syntax tree representing one particular program.

CYK and Earley are context-free grammar parsing algorithms. They determine grammatical structure or membership of an input sequence. They are different tasks from Thompson construction, which builds a token-recognizing NFA from a regular expression, and subset construction, which turns an NFA into a DFA.

sources.title: GNU Bison: Languages and Context-Free Grammars

additions.title: Equivalent specifications for ordinary token languages
paragraphs: Classical regular expressions, consistently right-linear regular grammars and finite automata describe the same regular-language family. Thus an ordinary token pattern specified by a regular expression also has a regular grammar and an equivalent finite-state recognizer.

This equivalence concerns expressive power, not spelling of the specification or implementation size. Context-free grammars can also describe regular languages, but their larger family is needed for syntax with unbounded nested structure rather than ordinary regular token patterns.

Automata and complexity theory · PDF page 8

additions.title: Target-aware instruction scheduling
paragraphs: Instruction scheduling orders selected target instructions while preserving dependencies. A target-aware scheduler also considers instruction latencies and the processor resources needed by each operation. This is a backend optimization whose performance choices depend on the target machine, even when a reusable scheduling framework serves many targets.

By contrast, constant folding, dead-code elimination and safe loop-invariant motion can be expressed on a target-neutral IR using values, control flow and side-effect rules. Target costs can still influence whether a legal transformation is worthwhile. Machine independence therefore describes the abstraction of a pass, not freedom from all language semantics or implementation costs.

additions.title: Model-specific core and thread counts
paragraphs: Intel’s desktop comparison chart lists the Core i7-920 with four physical cores and eight hardware threads. Core count and thread count are distinct specification fields: use the exact processor model and the field requested rather than inferring a count from the Core i7 family name.

sources.title: Intel Core i7 Desktop Processor Comparison Chart

additions.title: Buses as shared communication paths
paragraphs: A bus is a set of common signal lines used to transfer binary information among connected units. In a parallel register bus, one line carries each bit position; control signals select a source and enable the intended destination. Storage registers and memory retain information, while the bus provides a transfer path.

additions.title: The basic single-accumulator memory instruction
paragraphs: In the textbook single-accumulator organization, a memory-reference instruction has an operation part and an address part. The address locates a memory operand; the operation combines that operand with the accumulator as required. The address field is not the operand value itself, and this simple format does not describe every addressing mode or instruction set.

additions.title: Textbook instruction-set and control tendencies
paragraphs: RISC means Reduced Instruction Set Computer; CISC means Complex Instruction Set Computer. The textbook RISC design pairs a relatively large register set, load/store access and easily decoded instructions with hardwired rather than microprogrammed control and an efficient pipeline. These are design tendencies, not guarantees of one-cycle latency or lower power for every implementation.

additions.title: Instruction and stack pointers in 64-bit x86
paragraphs: In Intel 64-bit mode, RIP holds the offset of the next instruction to execute. RSP is the 64-bit stack pointer, extending the ESP/SP stack role. These pointers are distinct from CS and SS, which are code and stack segment registers.

sources.title: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer’s Manual, Volume 1 · §§3.4–3.5 and 6.1

additions.title: Exclusive-OR notation
paragraphs: The circled plus symbol ⊕ denotes exclusive OR. For two Boolean inputs, A⊕B is 1 exactly when the inputs differ; an overbar or output inversion would complement this result.

sources.title: Texas Instruments SNx4HC86 Quadruple 2-Input XOR Gates · description

additions.title: Bistable one-bit state
paragraphs: A flip-flop is bistable: it has two stable states representing 0 and 1. While powered, it can retain one bit until an input or designated clock event changes its state. Multiple flip-flops are required to represent a multi-bit counter state.

additions.title: Empty braces initialize aggregate members
paragraphs: For an aggregate with no default member initializers, empty braces initialize its members recursively. Numeric scalar members become zero, and the elements of a character-array member become zero characters. A zero character at the beginning of such an array makes it an empty, terminated C string. This differs from leaving an ordinary automatic scalar or array uninitialized.

additions.title: High-level languages and scripting usage
paragraphs: Python is a high-level programming language with built-in high-level data types. Calling a language a scripting language describes a common way it is used; it does not make that language machine code or assembly. Language level and execution style are different classifications.

additions.title: Keywords and names have different roles
paragraphs: A keyword is a reserved word with a predefined meaning in the language grammar. It cannot be repurposed as an ordinary variable or function name. An identifier is a name used to refer to a data object or function; its spelling must obey the identifier-character rules and avoid keywords.

additions.title: Java print and println preserve output layout
paragraphs: Java System.out.print writes the supplied value without automatically ending the line. System.out.println writes its value and then a line separator. Successive println calls therefore place their values on separate lines, even when each printed expression also contains a trailing space.

sources.title: Java SE 17 — PrintStream print and println

additions.title: An assignment expression can accidentally become a condition
paragraphs: In C++, simple assignment changes its left-hand object, and the assignment expression refers to that updated object. When an ordinary numeric assignment is used as a condition, the newly assigned value is converted to truth: zero is false and nonzero is true. Equality testing with == instead produces a Boolean result without assigning either operand. Confusing the two can both change program state and choose an unintended branch.

sources.title: C++ working draft — Assignment and compound assignment operators

additions.title: Command injection and the data-to-command boundary
paragraphs: OS command injection occurs when an application lets untrusted input affect a command executed by the host operating system, often through unsafe construction of a shell command. The command runs with the application's effective privileges. This is an injection flaw in command interpretation, unlike fuzzing, which supplies varied inputs to discover defects.

Prefer a suitable library API over constructing a shell command. Where command execution is required, keep the executable and arguments under strict control and validate against the expected permitted structure; merely blocking a few suspicious characters is not a general proof of safety.

additions.title: WannaCry: ransomware and worm propagation
paragraphs: WannaCry, also known as WannaCrypt, is ransomware with worm-like propagation. It encrypts files and demands payment to restore access. Its name identifies malicious software rather than a network-security protocol. Malware names must be distinguished from defensive controls such as intrusion detection, intrusion prevention and physical protection.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender Security Research Team — WannaCrypt ransomware worm targets out-of-date systems

additions.title: Distinguish network roles and protocol names
paragraphs: A router forwards IP packets between networks; forwarding alone is different from detecting suspicious behavior or enforcing a firewall's security policy. SNMP means Simple Network Management Protocol and provides a framework for monitoring and controlling managed devices through management information. It is not a remote-shell service.

AAA names authentication, authorization and accounting functions, rather than a particular remote-shell channel. SSH expands to Secure Shell and provides secure remote login and related network services. PGP expands to Pretty Good Privacy; its message-protection design combines conventional and public-key encryption with digital signatures. Protocol purpose matters when several technologies all contribute to security.

RFC 4251 — The Secure Shell Protocol Architecture
RFC 1991 — PGP Message Exchange Formats (historical terminology)

additions.title: Independent routing classifications
paragraphs: Adaptive or dynamic routing changes routes in response to updated network information; nonadaptive or static routing uses configured choices. Distributed routing means routers perform computations using exchanged information instead of requiring one central route computation. These properties do not imply random next-hop selection: the path-selection rule is a separate classification.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 19
RFC 1058 — Distance-vector computation and topology changes

additions.title: Management, traffic service and application transport bindings
paragraphs: SNMP means Simple Network Management Protocol. Its management applications monitor and control managed devices, such as hosts and routers, by exchanging management information with their agents. This device-management role differs from transferring email, resolving names or mapping an IP address to a MAC address.

In the conventional service bindings, FTP control, SMTP mail transfer and Telnet remote terminals use TCP. DNS supports both UDP and TCP on port 53; it is not exclusively a UDP service. The application protocol’s service role is distinct from the transport carrying its messages.

Quality of service (QoS) controls traffic treatment to meet objectives such as throughput, delay, jitter or loss. Classification, queue scheduling and allocation of buffer or bandwidth resources implement such treatment. QoS concerns delivered service behavior; scalability concerns accommodating growth, and security concerns unauthorized actions.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 28

additions.title: Why IPv4 conservation and IPv6 matter
paragraphs: The finite IPv4 address space has faced allocation scarcity. Private addressing with NAT conserves public IPv4 addresses, while IPv6 provides a much larger address space.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 19

additions.title: Computer networks and network interfaces
paragraphs: A computer network connects computers or other devices so they can exchange information and share resources such as files, storage and printers. The interconnection uses both hardware and software; neither hardware alone nor software alone is the definition of the whole network.

NIC expands to Network Interface Card. It is the host’s network interface, providing the connection through which the host sends and receives network signals. A cable connector attaches the medium to that interface; it is distinct from an intermediary switch or router.
bullets: CRC expands to Cyclic Redundancy Check.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 22
Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 23
Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 13

additions.title: Network-access technologies and geographic use
paragraphs: Ethernet and Token Ring are traditional LAN technologies. X.25 and Frame Relay are traditional WAN technologies. TCP/IP can run over different network-access technologies; its Internet-layer packet service does not require one particular link medium or frame format.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 26

additions.title: Interface addresses and transport-number namespaces
paragraphs: An IP address identifies a network interface rather than limiting a whole computer to one address. A computer or router can have several interfaces and addresses. Under a supplied IPv4 prefix, leading bits identify the network and the remaining bits identify an address within that network; a MAC address is a separate link-layer identifier.

TCP and UDP port fields are 16 bits, allowing numbers from 0 through 65535. Well-known ports are 0–1023, registered ports are 1024–49151, and dynamic/private ports are 49152–65535. Client endpoints can use dynamically selected ports instead of every application requiring a well-known assignment. These port numbers are distinct from the IP version and upper-protocol fields.

A bridge or switch’s MAC address table is its learned forwarding database: it associates MAC addresses with ports for frame forwarding. It differs from an ARP cache, which associates an IPv4 next hop with a link address, and from a routing table, which selects next hops for IP prefixes.

A common IPv6 unicast subnet uses a 64-bit subnet prefix and a 64-bit interface identifier. This split does not make the complete address 64 bits: it remains 128 bits. Special uses and explicitly different prefix lengths must be considered separately.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 18
Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 28
Cisco — Configure MAC address learning and forwarding tables
RFC 7421 — Analysis of the 64-bit boundary in IPv6 addressing

additions.title: Physical signaling and legacy Ethernet cable roles
paragraphs: Fiber-optic links can use near-infrared light. The selected optical wavelength is part of the link’s physical signaling specification, just as connectors and electrical signal levels are physical-interface specifications. This does not require every fiber link to use the same wavelength.

For legacy fixed Ethernet port roles, PCs and router Ethernet endpoints use the same endpoint role, while ordinary switch ports use the opposite role. Thus a direct router-to-PC link uses crossover wiring; PC-to-switch or router-to-switch uses straight-through wiring. Automatic MDI-X can remove the need to choose the crossover manually.

Ethernet switches can have fiber-optic interfaces with suitable optical transceivers. A forwarding role therefore does not impose a copper-only restriction: distinguish what the device does with frames from the physical medium used by its ports.

Intermodulation distortion occurs when multiple signals interact through a nonlinear component and generate unwanted combination-frequency products. Its mechanism differs from random thermal motion, adjacent-channel leakage and an isolated impulse disturbance.

additions.title: Best, average and worst compare equal-size inputs
paragraphs: Fix the input size before comparing cases. Best-case cost is the minimum resource use over legal inputs of that size; worst-case cost is the maximum. Average-case cost averages costs using a stated input distribution. These three input-case functions can each be described using upper, lower or tight asymptotic bounds; the case name does not select the bound notation.

For successful binary search with all stored positions equally likely, average probes have order Theta(log n). The probe decisions form a binary tree: only a bounded number of positions occur in shallow levels, while a constant fraction require logarithmic depth. Interval halving also gives the logarithmic upper bound. A distribution concentrating on an immediate midpoint hit would give a different average.

NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures — Worst case

Sedgewick and Wayne — Algorithms, binary-search symbol-table average costs

additions.title: Queues for deferred interrupt work
paragraphs: An interrupt service routine may need to record work quickly and defer its completion. Operating systems can queue that deferred work for later processing; Windows deferred procedure calls are one concrete example. This is a queue application, but it does not imply that every interrupt system uses a single FIFO service policy.

additions.title: Linked nodes and multiway tree branching
paragraphs: A linked binary-tree node stores a payload and two child pointers, one for the left child and one for the right child. A null child pointer means that child is absent; a root pointer gives access to the whole tree. In a dynamically allocated version, insertion can allocate a node and attach it through the appropriate child link.

A B-tree is a balanced multiway search tree. Its allowed branching factor can exceed two, so a general B-tree is not the binary-tree family. Balanced describes a height discipline; it does not by itself restrict every node to two children.

sources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 9
Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 5
NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures — B-tree

additions.title: Recognize recursive divide-and-conquer structure
paragraphs: Divide and conquer reduces a problem to smaller instances of the same kind, solves the required smaller instances and obtains the original result from them. Mergesort recursively sorts two halves and merges; quicksort partitions and recursively sorts the resulting ranges. This course also classifies binary search as divide and conquer: an ordered comparison selects the only half that can contain the target. This is different from simply repeating adjacent swaps, choosing successive minima, or making stable LSD digit passes.

sources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 11
Data Structures and Algorithms · PDF page 3

additions.title: Algebra operator lists and derivable operations
paragraphs: A list of basic relational-algebra operators is a teaching convention, distinct from a claim that every listed operation is logically indispensable. Database System.pdf uses selection, projection, Cartesian product, set difference, union and intersection as its basic-operation list. Natural join and assignment are not members of that particular list.

Under set semantics, union includes tuples from either compatible input, intersection retains tuples common to both, and difference keeps first-input tuples absent from the second. Intersection can be expressed using difference, while a matching join can be expressed as selection over a Cartesian product. A smaller primitive basis may therefore omit intersection even though the module teaches it as basic.

additions.title: Relational systems with richer types
paragraphs: An object-relational DBMS retains relational data management while supporting richer extensions such as user-defined data types, functions and operators. PostgreSQL is an example. Richer relational types do not by themselves require all data to form a parent–child tree; that representation is the defining concern of hierarchical modeling.

additions.title: Programmed computation and learned patterns
paragraphs: A conventional computer manipulates digital information according to a program or sequence of instructions. Programs can implement storage, retrieval and learning operations. Neural networks can learn pattern recognition from examples, so executing instructions and learning patterns are not mutually exclusive descriptions. This provides no universal claim that every machine is better or worse than every human at completing missing information.

AI algorithms are not exclusive to one programming language. Rumale is a Ruby machine-learning library with classification and clustering implementations, demonstrating that Ruby can implement learning algorithms as well as the general-purpose languages already discussed. Language choice and learning regime are different decisions.

sources.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence · PDF page 71

additions.title: Ordered lookup versus state-space traversal
paragraphs: Binary search exploits the order of a sorted sequence: a comparison narrows the remaining candidate interval instead of exploring arbitrary successor states. Array bisection therefore differs from breadth-first or depth-first traversal of a general state-space graph. A storage container such as an array does not by itself specify FIFO or LIFO frontier behavior.

sources.title: Python documentation — Array bisection and searching sorted lists
Introduction to Artificial Intelligence · PDF page 18

additions.title: Agent task models and practical planning
paragraphs: An AI task is modeled as an agent interacting with its environment: observations enter through sensors and selected actions affect the environment through actuators. This task-level description differs from an agent implementation, which combines a program with a computing architecture.

In ordinary usage, rationality means reasonable, sensible judgment. For an AI agent, the operational criterion is the action with the best expected performance given its percept history and available knowledge, rather than guaranteed success or knowledge of the actual future.

Planning constructs actions to reach a goal. Scheduling additionally assigns activities to times and resources while respecting constraints such as resource conflicts and precedence. It is an AI application when search or constraint reasoning chooses feasible or useful assignments; automated telescope experiment scheduling is an example.

sources.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence · PDF page 11
Introduction to Artificial Intelligence · PDF page 7

additions.title: Attributing the name of artificial intelligence
paragraphs: John McCarthy is credited with coining the term artificial intelligence in the 1955 proposal for the Dartmouth summer research project. The Dartmouth workshop took place in 1956 and helped establish the field. Naming the field does not mean that one person invented all its ideas or methods.

sources.title: Stanford HAI — What is Artificial Intelligence?
Dartmouth — Artificial Intelligence Coined at Dartmouth

additions.title: Related search and game-evaluation methods
paragraphs: Simulated annealing follows a current candidate and randomly samples a neighboring move. It accepts improvements and sometimes accepts worse moves according to a temperature that decreases over time. Unlike genetic search, its defining mechanism is not a population undergoing parent selection, crossover and mutation.

For two admissible heuristics, h₂ dominates h₁ when h₂(n)≥h₁(n) for every node. Dominance compares estimates; it is not itself a condition ensuring that an arbitrary heuristic never overestimates. Both estimates must separately satisfy the relevant admissibility assumptions.

A Monte Carlo game simulation samples possible continuations and uses their outcomes to estimate position value. An evaluation function is the scoring mapping itself; sampling is one way of obtaining an estimate, while minimax backs values up and alpha–beta removes branches that cannot affect that backed-up decision.

sources.title: Russell and Norvig — Informed Search and Exploration
Silver et al. — Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search

additions.title: Prediction, transfer and explicit representations
paragraphs: Transfer learning reuses representations or a model learned on an earlier task for a new task, for example adapting pretrained image features to new image classes. This is a reuse strategy, not a specification that the new task has no labels or rewards.

Support-vector machines include supervised classification and regression methods. They use support vectors in their decision function rather than being defined by a next-state conditional-dependence assumption. In estimation, variance measures how predictions change across different training samples; overfitting instead names poor generalization caused by fitting training-specific details.

An ontology describes entities or individuals, classes and properties and may state logical relationships and restrictions. It organizes explicit conceptual knowledge. Conditional probability tables and a probabilistic factorization are additional modeling commitments, not inherent in the word ontology.

An application programming interface (API) exposes defined operations through which software requests functionality. It can be an interface used by an agent, but the interface alone is not the general entity that perceives an environment and selects actions.

additions.title: Behavior tests, understanding and software tests
paragraphs: Searle’s Chinese-room argument challenges whether executing formal symbol-manipulation rules is sufficient for understanding. It is a philosophical argument about understanding, not the conversational judge-and-hidden-participant procedure of the Turing test.

Black-box software testing examines externally visible functionality without inspecting implementation internals. A specification may concern any software behavior; this testing method does not by itself require conversational indistinguishability from a human.

sources.title: John Searle — Minds, Brains, and Programs (author draft)

additions.title: Operations principles versus development and delivery models
paragraphs: Least privilege limits an account or process to the rights its task needs. Agile development instead organizes frequent delivery and adaptation of software. Object-oriented programming organizes software around objects with state and behavior. Cloud computing supplies on-demand access to a shared pool of configurable computing resources. A development approach or hosting model does not itself define an access-rights principle.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 43
NIST SP 800-145 — The NIST Definition of Cloud Computing

additions.title: Disaster recovery as a planning objective
paragraphs: Disaster recovery planning prepares for restoring systems and data after disruptive loss. Regular protected backups and tested restoration are part of that plan. Continuing operation despite a component failure is a fault-tolerance objective; possessing extra components alone does not establish that older valid data can be recovered.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 30

additions.title: Initialization, shutdown and filesystem-check tools
paragraphs: In a traditional SysV-style system, init starts and supervises configured processes; /etc/inittab is its configuration file. The halt command stops the system through the supported shutdown procedure. Neither initialization, shutdown nor their configuration file is a filesystem-consistency check; fsck supplies that separate checking and optional repair role.

additions.title: What an ICMP reachability probe actually tests
paragraphs: Ping uses ICMP echo messages to test IP reachability. A reply shows that the addressed host and path support that exchange; no reply alone does not prove the host is disconnected, because filtering or loss can suppress responses. Traceroute instead discovers responding intermediate hops through packet-lifetime expiry; it is a path-discovery diagnostic, not the same question as an end-to-end echo test.

sources.title: Data Communication and System Admin · PDF page 27

additions.title: Distinguish scripting features by their responsibility
paragraphs: Exception handling transfers control from a failing operation to a matching handler. A try block contains the attempted work; an except clause handles specified raised exceptions. A loop repeats operations, a conditional chooses an ordinary branch, and a function packages reusable work; these constructs do not by themselves intercept exceptions.

A module groups definitions and statements that can be imported. A class bundles data with functionality for its objects. These organize a program, while command-line parsing interprets the arguments and flags supplied at invocation. Their implementation can use functions or classes, but organization alone does not parse arguments.

A signal handler responds when a process receives a specified asynchronous event notification. Handling such a notification is distinct from reading CPU or memory measurements through an OS interface, a performance counter or a log that actually records the metric.

sources.title: Python library — Signal handlers for asynchronous events

additions.title: Identifiers, literals and source comments
paragraphs: An identifier is a programmer-chosen name for an entity such as a class, method or variable. A reserved keyword has a language-defined role and cannot be used as an ordinary identifier. A literal writes a value directly, such as an integer, floating-point number, quoted character, quoted string or Boolean value.

A single-line Java comment begins with // and continues to the end of that line. A block comment begins with /* and ends with */. A documentation comment begins with /** and ends with */ and can be processed by Javadoc. Comment text does not execute as program statements.

For ordinary ASCII Java identifiers, the first character is a letter, underscore or dollar sign; later characters may also be digits. A reserved keyword is not an ordinary identifier, and a lone underscore is not a valid identifier in Java 17.

additions.title: Java 17 floating-point evaluation and printed doubles
paragraphs: Java 17 float uses IEEE 754 binary32, and double uses binary64. Successive multiplications group from left to right. Each floating-point operation rounds to its representable result, using nearest-value rounding with ties to even; regrouping a product can change its result.

PrintStream.print(double) converts the stored value through String.valueOf and Double.toString. For finite nonzero magnitudes from 0.001 inclusive to 10000000 exclusive, the standard decimal form uses at least one fractional digit and only the further digits needed to distinguish the value from adjacent doubles. println(double) also adds a line terminator. This is not fixed-decimal-place formatting.

A print call emits its value without inserting a separator or ending the line. A println call emits its value followed by a line terminator. Spaces must come from the supplied text or explicit output operations; adjacent calls do not automatically separate their values.

sources.title: Java SE 17 JLS — Floating-point expressions and multiplication

additions.title: Expression results, assignment and control headers
paragraphs: Java relational comparisons (<, <=, >, >=) and equality tests (==, !=) produce primitive boolean truth values. Their result is not an integer truth code or a value of the numeric operand type.

The conditional expression condition ? whenTrue : whenFalse requires a boolean or Boolean condition. It evaluates only the selected alternative. An integer or floating-point first operand is a compile-time error.

Assignments group right to left: a=b=c assigns c to b, then the resulting value to a. A later assignment overwrites an earlier value. Compound assignments update the left variable using the indicated operation.

Prefix ++ and -- update a variable before supplying its value; postfix forms supply the old value before the update. Multiplication, division and remainder bind before addition and subtraction; same-level binary arithmetic groups left to right. Integer division truncates toward zero. Unary plus preserves its numeric operand’s value.

A while header is while(condition). A basic for header is for(initialization; condition; update). A do-while statement places its condition after the body. An if selects its true branch or, when present, its else branch; only the selected branch executes.

For Boolean values, ! reverses true and false, && is true only when both operands are true, and || is true when at least one is true. Short-circuit evaluation skips an unnecessary right operand. For each binary column, integral & produces 1 only for two 1 bits, | produces 1 for either 1 bit, and ^ produces 1 for differing bits.

An unlabeled break leaves the innermost enclosing loop or switch. continue moves to the next iteration step, while return leaves the current method and may supply a return value. These transfers have different destinations; return is not merely a loop exit.

additions.title: Core package membership and text values
paragraphs: The base Exception class is java.lang.Exception. It does not belong to java.io merely because some subclasses represent I/O failures. Package membership and position in an inheritance hierarchy are separate facts.

Calendar and Date are classes in java.util; Collection is an interface in that package. java.util also contains Arrays and Scanner. java.net supplies networking facilities; java.awt supplies the Button and Checkbox UI controls described in the package overview.

A String represents a sequence of UTF-16 code units. A single char represents one code unit rather than an entire String. String objects are immutable; changing a reference to another String does not modify the original text value.

A double-quoted string literal denotes a String object. new String(existingString) creates a String with the same text; new String(charArray) copies the array’s characters into an immutable String. A single-quoted literal denotes one char, so several characters enclosed together in single quotes cannot supply a String.

Character.toUpperCase(ch) supplies the uppercase equivalent where one exists; Character.toLowerCase(ch) supplies the lowercase equivalent. Character.isDigit(ch) tests whether a character is a digit and returns boolean. Character.toString(ch) supplies a one-character String rather than converting letter case.

additions.title: Inheritance boundaries and whole-part relationships
paragraphs: In Java’s class-declaration terminology, constructors are not members and are not inherited. A subclass can invoke superclass construction; this does not turn the superclass constructor into an inherited subclass method.

Aggregation models one instance grouping other instances as a whole with parts. It is an object-relationship concept, not a method-dispatch rule. Inheritance instead relates a specialized class to a general class; overridden operations can then provide polymorphic behavior.

additions.title: Introductory Java characteristics
paragraphs: The introductory module characterizes Java as object oriented, platform independent and simple. Its architecture-neutral bytecode is executed by a compatible platform-specific JVM. “Simple” is a teaching characterization relative to language design, not a promise that every learner finds every Java program easy.

additions.title: UNIX origins and the first four historical generations
paragraphs: UNIX development began at Bell Labs in 1969, led by Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie with other collaborators. Ritchie is therefore a co-creator, not the sole inventor of the first operating system.

The later UNIX time-sharing system described by Ritchie and Thompson is multiuser and interactive and supports asynchronous processes. Its later versions incorporated multiprogramming. This history does not make UNIX the first system ever to multitask.

In the first four generations of the cited NYU teaching taxonomy, the first generation uses vacuum tubes and manual single-user operation without a separate resident OS. The second generation pairs transistors with uniprogrammed batch systems; the resident OS starts successive jobs without being reloaded for every job.

The third generation pairs integrated circuits with multiprogramming. The fourth emphasizes personal computers. These are characteristic-era associations, not claims that each feature existed exclusively in one era.

Ritchie and Thompson — The UNIX Time-Sharing System
NYU OS 2250 — History of Operating Systems

additions.title: Thread management costs and execution privilege
paragraphs: In the conventional library-thread comparison, user-level thread creation and switching can avoid entering the kernel. Kernel-managed thread creation and management commonly incur additional kernel work, so the module describes them as generally slower to create and manage. This is a typical comparison, not a universal speed or reliability guarantee.

Being scheduled or managed by the kernel does not give application thread code kernel privilege. Ordinary applications and supporting utilities execute in restricted user mode and request protected services through libraries and system calls. Kernel component code executes in privileged kernel mode and performs permitted low-level hardware operations.

additions.title: Memory allocation and page-policy decisions
paragraphs: Memory management tracks which primary-memory regions are free or in use, assigns memory to processes and data, and deallocates it when no longer needed or when a process terminates. Allocation and deallocation concern memory ownership; CPU selection belongs to scheduling.

A buddy allocator manages power-of-two block sizes. It takes a smallest sufficient block, splitting larger blocks when necessary, and can merge a freed block with its free buddy. This is not the worst-fit rule of selecting the largest arbitrary hole.

A fetch policy decides when contents are brought into memory; demand paging fetches a valid nonresident page when it is accessed. A cleaning policy concerns writing modified contents to backing storage. A replacement policy chooses which resident page to evict. These decisions can cooperate during one page fault, but they are different decisions.

additions.title: Communication endpoints and timed I/O events
paragraphs: In the descriptor-based socket API, socket() creates a communication endpoint and returns its descriptor. connect() associates the socket with the requested peer address; send() transmits data to another socket. Receiving through read() uses the ordinary descriptor-input interface described in the file-services lesson.

IRQ means interrupt request. A controller can raise an interrupt to request CPU attention. In a clock-tick scheduler, the scheduler initializes a running process’s quantum counter; each clock interrupt decrements it, and reaching zero triggers scheduling. Clock support also maintains time of day and usage accounting.

Direct message communication names the receiving process explicitly. Indirect communication uses a mailbox or port. This naming distinction is independent of whether a send or receive blocks: naming a destination does not determine synchronization semantics.
